correctness.rationale: The proof was reconstructed for arbitrary \(n\), not inferred from finite tests. For each character, Riemann--Roch and Serre duality on \(\operatorname{Bl}_4\mathbf P^2\) reduce \(h^1\) to the pair \((d,k)\); the edge-sum identities exclude multiple \(b_v=2\) vertices in the low-\(d\) cases. The only contributions are \((2,1)\) and \((4,4)\), each of multiplicity one in cohomology. Their character counts are respectively \(4\binom{n-1}{2}\) and \(\binom{n-1}{2}\). An independent exact enumeration for \(2\le n\le8\) reconstructed all \(n^5\) characters and reproduced \(q=0,5,15,30,50,75,105\), serving only as a consistency check. The displayed \(p_g\) and degree-zero local-cohomology dimension then follow from the stated Euler characteristic and standard section-ring correspondence.
